Locked-off camera looking straight up, framing holds. From the first half second the seven bounce on the beat and stab their gloved fingers down at the lens. On the first beat the small woman in the canary-yellow coat, at the top of the ring, leans in furthest and jabs; on the next BOTTLE and CRIMSON lean in, heads dipping toward the lens; then MARINE chops a flat palm down while RUST pumps his pointing hand twice, and she jabs again. She moves with swagger and attitude the whole time: chin up, hips leading, a loose bratty shoulder roll on the beat, never stiff. A fresh move each beat, shoulders dropping on the downbeat. The airship hangs still. Masks, gloves and clothes unchanged. SFX: gloved claps, cloth rustle, high wind.

Thanks.
